headline: Over 50 rescued as fire breaks out at Gazipur garment factory
summary: Nine fire service units are battling a blaze that started on the third floor of an eight-story building in the Degerchala area.
details: A fire broke out at the Matrix Garments factory in the Degerchala area of Gazipur city on Saturday afternoon.
The blaze reportedly started around 3:00 PM on the third floor of the eight-story factory building.
Nine units of the Fire Service and Civil Defence are currently working to bring the flames under control.
In addition to firefighting efforts, rescue operations are underway to save people trapped inside the building.
According to the Fire Service, more than 50 people had been rescued from the building by 4:15 PM.
caption:
Over 50 people rescued as a massive fire engulfs a garment factory in Gazipur.

A fire broke out at the Matrix Garments factory in the Degerchala area of Gazipur city on Saturday afternoon.

The blaze reportedly started around 3:00 PM on the third floor of the eight-story factory building.

Nine units of the Fire Service and Civil Defence are currently working to bring the flames under control.

In addition to firefighting efforts, rescue operations are underway to save people trapped inside the building.

According to the Fire Service, more than 50 people had been rescued from the building by 4:15 PM.

headline: 1,122 dead as measles outbreak kills 8 more in 24 hours
summary: The Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) reports a rising toll of suspected measles deaths across Bangladesh, with Dhaka Division the hardest hit.
details: Eight more suspected measles deaths were recorded in Bangladesh within a 24-hour period, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
This latest spike brings the total number of suspected measles-related deaths this year to 1,020, while laboratory tests have confirmed another 102 deaths, totaling 1,122 fatalities.
The DGHS reported that 43 people tested positive for measles during the same 24-hour window, with 1,013 people seeking hospital care for symptoms.
Dhaka Division has seen the highest number of suspected deaths with 463 cases, followed by Sylhet with 179 and Rajshahi with 93.
Other affected regions include Mymensingh (80), Chattogram (86), Barishal (60), Khulna (44), and Rangpur (15).
Overall, suspected measles cases have reached 195,197, of which 21,666 have been laboratory-confirmed. Hospital admissions have totaled 173,024.
caption:
1,122 deaths and nearly 200,000 suspected cases. Measles is claiming lives across Bangladesh.

Eight more suspected measles deaths were recorded in Bangladesh within a 24-hour period, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).

This latest spike brings the total number of suspected measles-related deaths this year to 1,020, while laboratory tests have confirmed another 102 deaths, totaling 1,122 fatalities.

The DGHS reported that 43 people tested positive for measles during the same 24-hour window, with 1,013 people seeking hospital care for symptoms.

Dhaka Division has seen the highest number of suspected deaths with 463 cases, followed by Sylhet with 179 and Rajshahi with 93.

Other affected regions include Mymensingh (80), Chattogram (86), Barishal (60), Khulna (44), and Rangpur (15).

Overall, suspected measles cases have reached 195,197, of which 21,666 have been laboratory-confirmed. Hospital admissions have totaled 173,024.
